title: Synaptic Plasticity
description: Cells that fire together wire together: a synapse grows stronger each time the cell before it and the cell after it are active at once, Δw = η·x·y. Left alone that runs away; real synapses also scale themselves back (Oja's rule), so a trained network keeps what it learnt without saturating. Unlocks the Synapse Trainer and the Synaptic Lattice upgrade.

puzzle.goal: A synapse of weight w joins a cell with activity x to a cell with activity y. Hebb: it strengthens in proportion to both. Write the change Δw in one step, with learning rate η.
puzzle.name: Hebb's rule
puzzle.ask: Find Δw for η = @{eta}, x = @{x} and y = @{y}.
puzzle.method: The change needs both cells active: the product of the two activities, scaled by how fast the synapse learns.
